arguments.description: Check ledger for S1946/S1947 and git status of coord
arguments.command:
Write-Output '--- AUDIT_LEDGER S1946/S1947/S1926'
Select-String -Path AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Pattern 'S1946|S1947|S1926' | Select-Object LineNumber,Line | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap | Out-String -Width 250
Write-Output '--- git status coord/tmp (untracked/modified)'
git status --short -- coord tmp/sheaf/xif/paper | Select-Object -First 60 | Out-String -Width 200
Write-Output '--- ledger size/mtime'
Get-Item AUDIT_LEDGER.md,coord/STATE.md,coord/queue.md | Select-Object Name,Length,LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200
